actual_scope: Prove an all-order generic linear ordinary Stein-rank floor for unshifted two-point Gaussian tensors, including an exact inverse transfer and the specified dense-generator storage consequence.
scope_change_reason: The preceding lexicographic rank and global-symmetry-cycle results leave arbitrary vertex orderings outside their scope. An attempted full generic determinant theorem remains open; the approved pivot proves a universal weaker rank bound through exact XOR-matching minors.

stop_rule: Stop after the stated proof and exact finite negative controls plus independent review. Do not infer source parameter genericity, rounded stability, full generic rank or kappa.
